programme.title: Forever And Ever
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po plays a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter. After marrying, he soon discovers the reason for her hesitation. She is stricken with a contagious disease. But, with the power of true love, their romance prevails.

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Dong and Chu plan to get married but their families who are lifelong rivals, disapproved. They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announces that they will release Dong's songs, leading to double bliss for the couple.

programme.title: The Eight Diagram Pole Fighter
programme.desc: The Yang Generals were ambushed by the enemies and only two of the sons survived. The fifth son of Yang's escapes to Shaolin temple and learns the pole-fighting techniques from the monks, eventually creating his own “Eight Diagram Pole Fight” and teaming up with the Shaolin monks to avenge his family.

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: The roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collects proof of corruption from the officials in this comedy-drama. After a string of blackmailing, they end up in positions of power, but what is to happen next?

programme.title: The Chinese Boxer
programme.desc: A Japanese karate master and Diao Er, who has been expelled from his martial arts school, return to the school to kill the school master and his disciples. After the massacre, disciple Lei Ming embarks on a vigorous training regime and vows to avenge their deaths. A fatal battle is about to begin...

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: The film is about the drugged, then disgraced wife of a peddler in the waning days of the Ching Dynasty. To make matters worse, she's soon framed for her husband's murder by her rapist, the son of the local magistrate! And even that is not the end of her woes in this emotional suspense...

programme.title: The Magnificent Ruffians
programme.desc: Renowned martial arts clan heir Yuan Ying Fei hires four down-and-out martial artists to eliminate the local escort agency's young chief, Guan Yuan. Unexpectedly, the four befriend Guan instead. When Yuan's conspiracy leads to Guan's death, they unite to avenge him.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Impoverished scholar Zhang Zhen seeks refuge with a chancellor's family, only to be scorned for his poverty. A carp spirit, moved by his plight, disguises herself as the chancellor's daughter and falls for him. Confusion over the two identical daughters draws a demon-hunting priest. Zhang Zhen refuses to abandon her, moving Guanyin to grant her mortal form.

programme.title: The Winged Tiger
programme.desc: If the two big villains Winged Tiger and Underworld King join forces, the martial arts world will be plunged into chaos. This evil union is set to occur with the marriage of the Underworld King's sister and the Winged Tiger. Can this dangerous duo be stopped before one says "I do"?

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bill's nieces!

programme.title: The Rebel Intruders
programme.desc: Thousands of displaced refugees rush to the southern towns to avoid the civil war in north China. Three such young men trained with martial arts skills become sworn brothers, and accidentally got involved in the battle of the rebel leaders in town when they save a refugee girl. Can they fight back against the rebel gangs?

programme.title: What Price Honesty
programme.desc: Three rookie constables refuse to collude with corrupt officials, making themselves targets of a deadly conspiracy. After losing comrades and witnessing the abuse of power, they abandon all hope of justice. Determined to avenge the fallen, they launch a bloody assault on the corrupt forces in a desperate fight for justice.

programme.title: A Taste Of Cold Steel
programme.desc: Gan Dai Xiong is killed by Prince Wu, who seeks to seize his Purple Sword. Prince Wu's son join forces with an evil gang to steal the Purple Sword from Gan Dai Xiong's three daughters. Eventually, Gan's daughters team up with their cousin Xu to avenge their father's death.

programme.title: Mission Impossible
programme.desc: A sword master's daughter is pursued and poisoned by an evil master when bringing back the stolen Golden Sword to the palace. She dies on the run and returns as a spirit to take revenge by killing the evil master, and soon vanishes after returning the sword to the emperor.

programme.title: Love without End(1961)
programme.desc: In this classic romantic melodrama, nightclub songstress Qing Qing falls for the handsome Peng Nan. However, the two go through an emotional roller coaster of misunderstandings, separations and mutual torment. When the two finally fall back into love, Qing Qing receives a shocking revelation that brings the story to its inevitable sad ending.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns to the screen with this seriocomic look at the clash of cultures which result when a Mainland Chinese peasant brings his family to Hong Kong. Family Light Affair, whose Chinese title literally translates as "City Lights", is the director/writer's warm-hearted memoir of street life back in the early 1980s, featuring an eclectic cast of pop music and kung fu stars who

programme.title: The Twelve Gold Medallions
programme.desc: Chancellor Qin Hui forges twelve gold medallions to recall General Yue Fei from the war's front line. Swordsman Miao Lung leads heroes to intercept them, only to find their leader is his mentor, Jin Yan Tang. Torn between loyalty and duty, the two clash in a duel. Miao Lung wrests the medallions, but cannot avert history's tragedy.

programme.title: Call of the Sea
programme.desc: A young fisherman, Chin Hu is in love with his childhood friend Hsiao Yu. However, the only son of a town bully lusts after Hsiao Yu's beauty and tries all possible ways to approach her. Chin Hu protects another woman from the bully one day, leading Hsiao Yu to misunderstand him and suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: The Secret Of The Dirk
programme.desc: The inhabitants of the City of Liu are forced to flee when the vicious Black Tigers gang raids their city, but are able to hide all their gold and treasures in a valley. A team of swordswomen led by Liu wants to get their hands on the treasures before the bandits, but both parties will have to contend with the wandering swordsman Chou for them...

programme.title: My Son
programme.desc: Kuo, a police's son, blames his father for his mother's death. He has no job, spends time in night clubs and always gets into fights. One night, Kuo rescues Mei from being raped and they become friends. Kuo wants to support Mei and her family so he goes gambling hoping to gain more money but bad luck seems to be following them with tragic outcomes.

programme.title: Vengeance
programme.desc: Yu Lou is betrayed by his wife and eventually killed by her lover, Fung, who is the boss of a martial arts school. Yu Lou's brother, Xiao Lou, knows about his tragic death and is determined to take revenge for him.

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

programme.title: Five Shaolin Masters
programme.desc: The Qing court plots to kill all Shaolin disciples by burning down Shaolin Temple. This sudden fire killed almost everyone except for five disciples. To take revenge on the Qing court, the five of them train hard in different fighting styles to become “The Five Shaolin Masters”.

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: A young musician Chi Chiang is hired by the manager of a popular band when the group's drummer/leader Charlie, quits to join a rival group. The new drummer becomes an immediate hit, causing Charlie to be very jealous. Furthermore, the young drummer's mother is dead set against him having a music career.

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: Kao Chien Fei is a young swordsman who wields a special sword with a teardrop marked on its blade. He is charged with averting an impending crisis in the martial arts world, but the villain, Zhou Tung Lai, wishes to become the ruler in the martial arts world, and launches a scheme to pit the various heroes against one another.

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Wealthy heir Ping Chien Jen spurns the family business for a travel agency with his girlfriend Su Yung Lan. While they are hosting visitors from Hong Kong, a student falls for Chien Jen, sparking tension. Consumed by jealousy, Yung Lan storms off, and the student crashes her car after learning of his engagement. Misunderstandings are eventually cleared, and happiness follows.

programme.title: The Iron Buddha
programme.desc: After a notorious rapist Xiao kills his master and the entire clan, Han the last surviving disciple, decides to take revenge. He must find the legendary Hulong Blade to counter Xiao's Evil Poisonous Sword, but as Han has never seen Xiao before, he is deceived when Xiao poses as an ally to try and steal his Blade in the process.

programme.title: The Big Sting
programme.desc: Three buddies find a rare artifact known as the Double-Faced God but are poisoned by Lady Wu who steals the treasure from them. Before they die, they get their wives to promise to train their children to take back what is rightfully theirs. These kids grow up to exact a vengeance that turns out to be more hilarious than horrific in this comedy.

programme.title: Killers Five
programme.desc: The Duke's daughter has been kidnapped by the notorious Golden Dragon Hill bandits. A swordman named Yue Zhen Bei is assigned to save her, and expecting many dangers on the journey, Yue garners help from a group of good friends who are also kung fu masters.

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: In the Ming Dynasty, scholar Tian Yu Chuan defends a fisherman's honour but accidentally kills the governor's son, driving him into exile. Pursued to the river's edge, he is rescued by the fisherman's daughter. Amid danger, love blossoms between them, and Tian seals their bond with his family heirloom, the Butterfly Chalice.

programme.title: The Proud Youth
programme.desc: Ling Hu Chong, a Huashan clan's disciple, is assigned to find the successor to the score “The Proud One”. Ling identifies Ying for the score but finds out that she is the daughter of the evil clan's leader. At the same time, he is unwittingly dragged into an epic power struggle between clans, with complicated allegiances and perplexing moralities.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: The Reckless Cricket
programme.desc: Inspired by “Drunken Master”, this kung fu comedy features a bumbling martial artist creating a cricket-style fighting arts to fight and defeat the different martial artists who have beaten him before.

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxu's enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power.

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s “a-go-go” era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: The Brave Archer
programme.desc: On his way back to the midlands, Guo Jing meets Huang Rong and they quickly fall in love. However, Ouyang Ke proposes to marry Huang Rong at the same time, so Huang's father sets up a duel for the two men to compete for her hand. Guo Jing finally beats Ouyang Ke to win Huang Rong back.

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: In this musical drama, Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl, falls in love with a handsome boatman Ta Lung. However, she cannot afford to marry him because of her father's towering debt from gambling. To complicate the matter, a rival suitor promises to pay off all her father's debts on one condition: that Hsiu Hsiu marries him...

programme.title: Super Inframan
programme.desc: Transformed from a young laboratory researcher, the thunderbolt-fisted Inframan must battle Princess Dragon Mom who wakes up from hibernation to conquer the earth with her army of mutant monsters.

programme.title: The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: Fang Ming marries the mysterious young lady Leng Qiu Ping, only to discover she is a spirit forced to drain men's life essence. With a Taoist's help, he frees her from an evil force, but their love cannot cross life and death, and they part at dawn in a bittersweet farewell.

programme.title: The Heroic Ones
programme.desc: Set in the Tang Dynasty, the 13 adopted sons of Sha Tuo King are all renowned as royal warriors. David Chiang plays the 13th Prince, a powerful fighter whose prestigious status provokes jealously, leading to a gruesome family feud.

programme.title: The Anonymous Heroes
programme.desc: Carefree drifters Meng Gang and Tie Hu discover their purpose after meeting the revolutionary leader, Wan Tai. With the help of Meng Gang's girlfriend, they infiltrate a warlord camp to seize weapons for the revolutionary cause. Following a fierce battle, all three make the ultimate sacrifice, becoming the "Anonymous Heroes" of the revolution.

programme.title: Swordsman at Large
programme.desc: Hsiao Shi Yi Lang is the Swordsman at large who everyone wants to kill. A magnificient sword is even created for this purpose though the blade is soon coveted more than the swordsman's death by it! Bandits, beauties and blade masters battle for survival in this exciting story of deceit, betrayal, and death.

programme.title: The Protectors
programme.desc: Ling Hsiao and Kuan Wang Lung are two guard chiefs working for an old convoy master. Lung is secretly in love with Fang Yen, the master's granddaughter but Yen is attracted to Ling Hsiao instead. In order to win her back, Lung sets up a trap to steal the convoy and frames Ling Hsiao for it.

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured by her mother-in-law into putting up with Blackie and offer $1M for her baby...

programme.title: Trilogy Of Swordsmanship
programme.desc: A kung fu anthology film consisting of three stories: a man embarrasses himself while trying to prove his worth to the father of the woman he loves; a courtesan in love with a general will need to deliver a notorious bandit in exchange for him not being executed; and a group of bandits forms a plan to rescue a new friend from being executed.

programme.title: The Bells of Death
programme.desc: Wei Fu is an unremarkable woodcutter. However, when psychotic marauders killed his family and abducted his sister, he goes through vigorous martial arts training with an expert swordsman in order to exact revenge on the evildoers.

programme.title: The Supreme Swordsman
programme.desc: After beating several famous swordsmen, Chin Wu Hsin of the Mo Shan clan challenges Supreme Swordsman to a duel, hoping to win his title, and is beaten and humiliated. The winner taunts him to find a Supreme Sword made by Old Eagle, a famous sword-maker. When his offer to buy a sword from Old Eagle, is turned down, he challenges Old Eagle to a duel, and snatches his sword in a foul play. Old Eagle

programme.title: A Friend from Inner Space
programme.desc: A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together.

programme.title: Shaolin Prince
programme.desc: Two royal brothers are separated as babies after a traitorous general usurps the throne. Raised apart, one within Shaolin Temple and the other by a noble lord, they grow into formidable martial artists. When destiny reunites them, the brothers must combine their deadly kung fu styles to overthrow the tyrant and avenge their fallen empire.

programme.title: The Younger Generation
programme.desc: A tragic tale about a young girl who gets married and has five kids. When she and her husband die, leaving all five kids behind to fend for themselves, the eldest child is forced to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

programme.title: The Silent Swordsman
programme.desc: Young swordsman Shen Bing Yi is appointed leader of the "Sun and Moon" secret society, sworn to take down a traitorous general conspiring with foreign invaders. While fighting for his nation, he captures the hearts of a spirited female warrior and two beautiful Uyghur princesses, leaving him caught between his duty and their devotion.

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: Marco Polo
programme.desc: Mongolian emperor Kublai Khan is being assassinated while meeting with the Italian explorer Marco Polo. Marco Polo is appointed to lead the troops for the emperor to wipe out the anti-Mongol rebels. Yet, he is touched by these rebels who are resisting the Mongolian invasion of their homeland. Will Marco Polo stay loyal to the emperor?

programme.title: The Web of Death
programme.desc: To rule the martial arts world, the Head of the Snake Sect seeks to possess a deadly plant called “Five Poison Web”, spreading rumours on its whereabouts. Brothers Xiong and Kit are sent to investigate. Xiong falls in love with Su who has a clue of where the plant is, but she accidentally hurts Kit when seeking the plant, devastating Xiong.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: One Way Only
programme.desc: Danny is a motorbike workshop owner, once was a renowned motorcycle racer, but were seriously injured in an illegal race. Mai, student of Danny, wins a race in Macau under Danny's help. However, because of money and honour, Mai joins illegal races. After knowing this, Li persuades Mai to stop illegal races, but Mai seems cannot find his way out...

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: Tales of a Eunuch
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao inadvertently enters the palace and unexpectedly befriends Emperor Kang Xi, whilst covertly serving rebels seeking the sacred “Sutra of Forty-Two Chapters”. Caught between rival factions when the Emperor seeks it too, Xiao Bao must rely on his quick wit and cunning to survive the perilous court and evade danger.

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn's beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong's concubine as he knows Dong's adopted son Lu Bu is in love with her, turning them against each other. Lu Bu ends up killing Dong Zuo to be with Diau Charn.

programme.title: Buddha's Palm
programme.desc: Young Long Jian Fei, a martial arts novice, is adopted by the Fire Spirit Demon who taught him the powerful Buddha's Palm, turning Long into a martial arts master. Long is tasked by the Fire Spirit Demon to takes revenge for his master, and this soon unleashes a storm upon the martial arts world...

programme.title: The Blue and the Black Part 2
programme.desc: Continuing from the first movie, Tang Qi ends her career as a nightclub singer and starts searching battle-scarred China for her lover Chang, who is now entangled with Japanese invaders, communist insurgents, and a warlord's beautiful daughter.

programme.title: Lady Of Steel
programme.desc: A young swordswoman Fang Ying Qi sets out to join the Flying Dragon Clan in their defense against the invading Jin forces. Fang also intends to avenge the murder of her parents by bandit leader Han 20 years ago. Han has since taken on a false identity as a member of the Flying Dragon Clan and Fang must rely on her deadly sword skills to stop Han.

programme.title: Big Times for the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Ah Niu finds a bag of jewels on the street and becomes rich. It is at this time that Uncle Zhou asks him to sign a contract to marry a girl, but it turns out to be a trap for Ah Niu to sell his house. In the end, Ah Niu becomes poor again...

programme.title: The Shadow Whip
programme.desc: Three hundred thousand worth of silver is robbed by a thief using a whip as the weapon. As it is a signature weapon used by a martial arts master “Shadow Whip”, he is suspected and hunted. No one sees him after that. Fifteen years later, a young girl Yang shows up using the same weapon. Who is this girl and what has happened to “Shadow Whip”?

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock 'n' roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

programme.title: Village of Tigers
programme.desc: The devilish residents of the Village of Tigers, led by Hu Jiao, plan to kill Lo Hong Shun, otherwise known as the heroic Sword of the Southern Sky. Hu Jiao sees a way to use the righteousness of the honorable Ba family to help him kill the hero Lo by turning them against him. Will good prevail over evil?

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung meets a famous courtesan in Suzhou and in order to spend as much time as possible with her, he builds a direct underground tunnel into the Forbidden City. The emperor's sudden appearances through this direct access shock his people but it is also at this time that he helps the needy and cracks the gambling business in Suzhou.

programme.title: The Rescue
programme.desc: Threatened by the Yuan who are closing in to rule the whole of China, a band of Song survivors band together to save their prime minister. This bold and fearless heroes fighting for their cause are led by international star, Lo Lieh (Glass Tears, Killer Clans) and Shi Szu (Lovers Destiny), who must fight their way out of trap after trap. But they can't escape them all, and eventually the two end u

programme.title: The Voyage of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung continues his incognito voyage to southern China. Accompanied by the minister and the imperial scholar, they have many amusing encounters in Yangzhou.

programme.title: Return of Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: A band of ninjas slaughters the entire Wu Dang Clan and frames Du Gu Wu Di, chief of the Invincible Clan, for the deed. Yun masters the silkworm martial arts style and decides to take revenge for the Clan by challenging Wu Di, but is defeated and seriously hurt. Luckily, Master Li saves and treats him, allowing Yun to avoid the ninjas' pursuit.

programme.title: The Kingdom and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Cheng Te meets country maiden Li Feng on a visit to Southern China. It was love at first sight and the Emperor leaves with a promise that Li Feng would be his empress. When he sends for Li one year later, she was too ill to withstand the arduous journey and arrives just in time to die in the arms of her beloved...

programme.title: The Golden Sword
programme.desc: Swordsman Long meets Feng while searching for his missing father and they soon fall in love and marry. When Long is kidnapped by 'Dragon Gate Palace' one day, Feng embarks on a rescue mission and reunites with Long, who manages to escape. Together, they confront the head of 'Dragon Gate Palace', and uncover a long-hidden secret.

programme.title: Hong Kong 73
programme.desc: In 1973, the Hong Kong Heng Seng Index hit extraordinary peaks and people from all walks of life go stock market crazy. Meanwhile, Hong Kong's social problems build up without anyone paying attention to what are actually happening to the crazy lives of people, in this mad city that many call home...

programme.title: The Assassin
programme.desc: Notorious assassin Nieh Cheng has retired into hiding. However, when Premier Yen's family is massacred, he seeks out the reclusive swordsman and coaxes him into a final revenge mission in this epic story set in the Six Kingdom era.

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City
programme.desc: Justice Bao discovers that Consort Li's new born son was swapped at birth and that she was expelled from the palace by Empress Liu twenty years ago. He sets Eunuch Guo up to confess his conspiracy with the Empress. Empress Liu is convicted for her act and Consort Li finally reunites with her son who is now the Emperor.

programme.title: Little Hero
programme.desc: An orphan, Little Bastard is taken on and trained as a fighter by a hermit. When Little Bastard grows up, he feels he is old enough to go out and look for his parents. Luckily for him, he befriends a beggar, Hsiao Yi, who being street-wise, manages to help him find his family, but somehow gets into trouble with the gang.

programme.title: The Twin Bracelets
programme.desc: Two teenage girls make a pledge to look after each other in a small Chinese fishing town, where the notions of women's rights or sexual freedom are absent. One ends up happily married to a stranger, while the other is cruelly betrothed to the abusive son of a wealthy family and has to seek to free herself from the situation.

programme.title: Duel For Gold
programme.desc: Six swordsmen, including two sisters and their husbands, a ranger and a security man, are trying to steal a million gold taels from the Fu Lai Treasury House, not knowing that one of them is actually an undercover hero. In their quest, they have to double-cross and outwit one another...

programme.title: The Magnificent Concubine
programme.desc: Yang Gui Fei is the beloved concubine of Emperor Tang Ming Huang, who is so besotted with her that he leaves the running of the country to Prime Minister Yang Guo Zhong, the brother of Yang Gui Fei. The Prime Minister is corrupt and cruel to the army, causing them to revolt and endanger the throne. Yang Gui Fei is also implicated and kills herself.

programme.title: Magnificent Wanderers
programme.desc: Lin and his two friends are traveling patriots who vow to stand up against violence and fight for justice. They meet a rich young man Chu by chance one day and the four become best friends. When a foreign prince plots to possess Chu's family fortune and goes after him, Lin and friends go all out to help Chu fight against the villain.

programme.title: The Crimson Charm
programme.desc: Yu Fang Fang survives the massacre of her master's family at the hands of the Crimson Charm gang but loses her arm in the process. Determined, she vows to team up with a swordsman seeking revenge against the ruthless gang.

programme.title: The Magic Blade
programme.desc: The movie depicts Fu Hong Xue fighting against the formidable conspirator Master Yu and seeing through his deception. The brilliantly choreographed fights, glorious settings, superb cinematography and strong casts define this movie as a highpoint in Wu Xia cinema.

programme.title: Asia-pol
programme.desc: Asiapol agent Yang Ming Xuan trails a shipment of contraband gold being delivered to gang leader, George Eaton. He enlists the help of a Chinese woman who is trying to avenge her sister and narrowly escapes several deadly traps as he closes in on Eaton's location. This spy film is loosely inspired by the James Bond movies.

programme.title: The Swordmates
programme.desc: Li asks his swordmate Wang to protect his family while he is away, but Wang rapes his wife and even has his convoy attacked. Li escaped but fears his daughter is still in danger, so he asks the nephew of his master to help protect her...

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf to win the lantern contest, while Zhao plans for revenge. When Long's wife suddenly disappears one day and he hears about the story of human lanterns, Long suspects Zhao may be involved in the incident...

programme.title: Love without End (1970)
programme.desc: Singer Qing Qing and architect Peng Nan are a devoted couple. Qing Qing sacrifices herself to help Peng Nan when his family is going through difficulties and is misunderstood by Peng Nan, leading to their break up. When Peng Nan learns the truth and decides to make up with Qing Qing, he finds out that she is suffering from a terminal illness.

programme.title: The Warlord
programme.desc: A bandit became a warlord in northern China by helping Russia fight against Japan. Due to his ignorance and silly behaviour, he is seen as a joke to everyone. The warlord is finally killed by the daughter of a troupe master whom he had killed for no reason, bringing a befitting end to a traitor.

programme.title: Men From The Monastery
programme.desc: At the end of the Ming Dynasty, Wu San Gui betrays his people by siding with the Qing and recruiting fighters from all backgrounds. Members of the Wudang and Emei sects are among the first to surrender and collude with local bullies. When they attack the Shaolin Monastery, its renowned disciples must unite to fight their enemies.

programme.title: The Bride Napping
programme.desc: A rich girl Yue Ying, together with her maid Chun Lan, encounter a poor scholar Bian Ji at a fête. Chun Lan realizes Yue Ying is in love with him, but mixes his identity with a bandit due to an old servant's confusion, threatening the couple's union. After a series of complications, misunderstandings and mismatches, Chun Lan finally saves the day.

programme.title: Long Road to Gallantry
programme.desc: Tu Meng Fei makes his way to the world after completing his kung fu training. En route, he rescues Mu Wan Erh and Li San Nan from a band of thugs and later learnt of a 20-year conflict between the evil Thunder Gang Chief Leng Tian Lei and the Dragon Sect. Mu's lost father is none other than the Thunder Gang Chief, who also killed Li's father...

programme.title: Legend of the Bat
programme.desc: It is rumoured that people can buy anything they desire on the mysterious Island of Bats so long as they have money. The charismatic swordsman Chu Liu Xiang and his friend travel to the island to seek answers but realize they are not the only ones who want to unveil the mystery of this place.

programme.title: RODA - RODA GILA - EP12
programme.desc: Roda-Roda Gila follows Elvano, a motorcycle enthusiast, and his romantic journey with Mika, the daughter of a veteran racer. Elvano falls for Mika when they first meet at a racing circuit, but their relationship faces opposition from their respective parents and friends.

programme.title: NALURI HATI - EP3
programme.desc: On her wedding day, Dinda is hesitant and still struggles to accept that she is about to get married. An incident prevents the wedding from taking place and leaves her with partial amnesia; she now knows herself as Nayla. Will her memories return, and what will happen between Nayla and a man she meets named Zain?

programme.title: MENCURI CINTA CEWEK BUAH NAGA
programme.desc: After Ridwan breaks up with her, accusing her of cheating, Shanice (Masayu Clara) becomes entangled with Farel (Alex Rio), a hot-tempered man who owns a dragon-fruit café. Farel has a sharp tongue, and Shanice wonders how she can soften his fiery temper.

programme.title: TAJWID CINTA - EP163
programme.desc: Dafri plans to return to Indonesia to meet Alina and get engaged, but his plans are disrupted when Syifa's wedding falls apart after her fiancé, Ilham, disappears. Dafri is eventually arranged to marry Syifa, whom he has only just met, because his father owes Syifa's parents a debt of gratitude. Their arranged marriage leads to a series of conflicts.

programme.title: Cinta Sat Set Dikejar Target Biar Mencapai Omset
programme.desc: Sheila (Aliyah Faizah), Meisya's older sister (Amanda Salmakhira), is about to marry Reno (Kevin Hillers). Just before the wedding, Sheila runs away, leaving Meisya expected to take her place. Meisya firmly rejects the idea, and Reno only wants to marry Sheila.

programme.title: RODA - RODA GILA - EP12
programme.desc: Roda-Roda Gila follows Elvano, a motorcycle enthusiast, and his romantic journey with Mika, the daughter of a veteran racer. Elvano falls for Mika when they first meet at a racing circuit, but their relationship faces opposition from their respective parents and friends.

programme.title: MAU HERAN TAPI KEPIKIRAN
programme.desc: It's surprising that Gabby and Gilang actually fall in love, considering Gilang was only Gabby's fan.

programme.title: NALURI HATI - EP4
programme.desc: On her wedding day, Dinda is hesitant and still struggles to accept that she is about to get married. An incident prevents the wedding from taking place and leaves her with partial amnesia; she now knows herself as Nayla. Will her memories return, and what will happen between Nayla and a man she meets named Zain?

programme.desc: Big boss Arya (Erdin Werdrayana) is too proud to confess his feelings for Rara (Syahnaz Sadiqah), even though they like each other. Will Arya finally tell Rara how he feels?

programme.title: TAJWID CINTA - EP164
programme.desc: Dafri plans to return to Indonesia to meet Alina and get engaged, but his plans are disrupted when Syifa's wedding falls apart after her fiancé, Ilham, disappears. Dafri is eventually arranged to marry Syifa, whom he has only just met, because his father owes Syifa's parents a debt of gratitude. Their arranged marriage leads to a series of conflicts.

programme.title: Lengah Dikit Langsung Diangkut Cintamu
programme.desc: Fathiya (Ina Marika) sells football jerseys by the roadside and is often chased by municipal enforcement officers. One day, while fleeing them, she throws her bag of merchandise toward a man standing beside his car. The man, Ridho (Cakrawala Airawan), is then stopped by the officers and taken to the police station despite explaining that the bag is not his.

programme.title: MAU MENDUA TAPI TAKUT FYP
programme.desc: Bulan (Yuriska Patricia) and her younger sister, Bintang (Tamara Tyasmara), travel to Jakarta after their aunt Dita promises them jobs. They discover that she has lied and intends to make them work as massage therapists. They refuse, then meet an elderly man who turns out to be the grandfather of Banyu (El Ryan Carlen).

programme.title: MENERIMA TUKAR TAMBAH AYANG
programme.desc: Dini's father stages an exchange of identities between Gito and Dini: Gito becomes a rich child while Dini becomes poor. Yet the switch does not erase the love between Dini and Gito.

programme.desc: Dalam kebimbangan minat remaja pada kerjaya kraftangan, pewaris gigih menjaga warisan ini. Rancangan ini memaparkan kerjaya kraftangan di Malaysia, menyeru penonton menghargai usaha mempertahankannya.

programme.title: (L) Re Bao
programme.desc: Re Bao memaparkan berita-berita terkini di seluruh Malaysia dalam bahasa Mandarin

programme.title: Space Between
programme.desc: In Niah caves, Sara's father risks his life harvesting bird nests, calling it a treasure hunt. Frustrated, Sara searches but finds none-until he reveals their true treasure: their heritage and love.

programme.title: The Food That Binds the Nation Ep09
programme.desc: Sebuah dokumentari kembara gastronomi yang merentas dari Perlis ke Sarawak, memperkenalkan keunikan juadah berbilang budaya yang memupuk perpaduan dalam kepelbagaian selera.

programme.title: (L) Berita Iban TVS
programme.desc: Berita Iban memaparkan berita-berita terkini di seluruh Malaysia dalam bahasa Iban

programme.title: (DL) Menarik Sepuluh
programme.desc: Menarik Sepuluh mengumpulkan 10 kisah unik dan menarik berlaku di mana sahaja

programme.title: (L) UTAMA 740
programme.desc: UTAMA 740 memaparkan berita terkini yang menyeluruh dan padat dari dalam dan luar negara.

programme.title: (DL) Detik Dunia
programme.desc: Detik Dunia membawakan rangkuman berita antarabangsa, mengetengahkan perkembangan global serta kisah-kisah yang membentuk landskap dunia hari ini.

programme.title: Decimal Point Ep13
programme.desc: Weekly business show is set to become your trusted source for all things business, economics, and current affairs. Your gateway to making informed decisions in today's fast-paced business environment.

programme.title: Sarawak Green Pulse Ep02
programme.desc: Sarawak Green Pulse is a three-part documentary series that journeys deep into Sarawak's rich ecosystems, from smouldering peat swamps to disappearing lakes, mangrove labyrinths to reborn forests.

programme.title: Travelawak Projek Bapak Bapak S4 Ep01
programme.desc: Back and wilder than ever! The cast faces unpredictable challenges in Hong Kong, Slovenia, and Romania. In a twist, one 'bapak' can't rejoin. Auditions for a new 'bapak' promise laughs and surprises.

programme.title: (L) TVS Nightline
programme.desc: Memaparkan laporan peristiwa yang berlaku di seluruh Malaysia dalam bahasa English

programme.title: As Husband as Wife
programme.desc: Zhou Quan resigns with excitement as his wife,Che Li,gains fame and becomes entrepreneur.He accepts a new job with a 20,000 yuan salary,with his wife as his boss and son as his client,starting a new life.

programme.title: Gerak Khas 2.0 Ep22
programme.desc: Pasukan elit polis menyiasat jenayah berprofil tinggi di Kuala Lumpur yang semakin berleluasa di Malaysia, di mana setiap kes bukan sahaja mencabar undang-undang, tetapi menguji kepercayaan, integriti.

programme.title: Fitrah Adam Ep13
programme.desc: Fitrah Adam mengupas tentang masalah dan cabaran yang dihadapi kaum lelaki dalam kehidupan. Malah, mereka sebagai ketua keluarga dalam membina sahsiah rumah tangga dan menjadi pemimpin.

programme.title: 3 Mak Dara S2 Ep05
programme.desc: 3 Mak Dara kembali untuk Musim Kedua dengan nafas baharu yang lebih bersahaja dan santai. Dihoskan oleh tiga orang selebriti tanah air iaitu Raja Azura, Sharifah Shahora dan Rita Rudaini.

programme.title: The Cloth Story Ep03
programme.desc: Menceritakan tentang keunikan batik, tenun, songket, busana dari peradaban melayu diselitkan dengan sedikit sejarah serta asal usul penghasilan kain.

programme.title: Gemilang Teater Bangsawan Ep02
programme.desc: Sejarah dan perkembangan seni teater bangsawan di Sarawak sebagai satu bentuk seni persembahan tradisional yang menggabungkan lakonan, muzik, tarian, dan cerita rakyat melalui perjalanan tukang cerita.

programme.title: Lawas Uncovered Ep01
programme.desc: Rancangan dokumentari 'Lawas Uncovered' memaparkan penerokaan sejarah, warisan, era peperangan, serta budaya dan kehidupan komuniti tanah tinggi di Daerah Lawas, Sarawak.

programme.title: Sarawak Green Pulse Ep02
programme.desc: Sarawak Green Pulse is a three-part documentary series that journeys deep into Sarawak's rich ecosystems, from smouldering peat swamps to disappearing lakes, mangrove labyrinths to reborn forests.

programme.title: Unearth Sarawak: Indigenous Cuisines Ep05
programme.desc: Showcases iconic and forgotten cuisines from Bidayuh, Melanau, Chinese, Iban, and Orang Ulu ethnics, aiming to preserve heritage cuisines, boost local communities, and promote gastronomy tourism.

programme.title: Sanggar Vista Ep07
programme.desc: Menjejak rumah-rumah cantik di Sarawak. Keindahan adalah subjektif, maka program ini menampil pelbagai jenis rumah, bukan hanya banglo mewah, tetapi juga rumah tradisional dan sederhana yang dihias indah.

programme.title: The Dangers in My Heart OVA Ep01
programme.desc: Spin-off series of 'The Dangers in My Heart', featuring stories that focus on the introverted Ichikawa and the naive Yamada in an everyday routine that'll make you chuckle!

programme.title: The Dangers in My Heart S2 Ep01
programme.desc: Ichikawa struggles at school with his broken arm. With Adachi's help, Yamada indirectly supports Ichikawa. Having felt Yamada's kindness, Ichikawa decides to tell her his feelings...

programme.title: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! Ep01
programme.desc: Nukumizu witnesses his classmate, Anna, get dumped, and gets to know the 'losing heroines', Lemon and Chika. Nukumizu's mysterious youth story revolving around these 'Makeines' begins!

programme.title: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! Ep02
programme.desc: Lemon invites Nukumizu to talk in the gym storage room, but they get locked inside. They get rescued as childhood friend Ayano visits Lemon. Then, they visit the Literature Club together...

programme.title: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! Ep03
programme.desc: Nukumizu and Komari debate about tap water. The Literature Club goes on a training camp to produce a web novel as proof of their club activities. At night, a fireworks accident happens...

programme.title: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! Ep04
programme.desc: Komari confesses to Tamaki. Tensions between Koto and Tamaki flare up as Koto leaves the site. Nukumizu escapes reality, but to no avail. Later, Nukumizu hears a rumor about him and Yanami.

programme.title: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! Ep05
programme.desc: Yanami visits Nukumizu and Kaju overreacts. Yanami invites Nukumizu to a cafe and they spot Lemon and Ayano together. They follow the two, but are approached by Ayano's girlfriend, Chihaya.

programme.title: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! Ep06
programme.desc: Ayano grills Nukumizu who was with Chihaya. He then misunderstands that Nukumizu likes Yanami. Including Lemon and Yanami, they hang out while Lemon tries to hook Ayano and Chihaya up, but...

programme.title: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! Ep07
programme.desc: Lemon tells Nukumizu her feelings for Ayano and confronts Ayano and Chihaya. Nighttime at school, Lemon and Ayano share their feelings and reminisce about the past. Lemon then makes a move...

programme.title: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! Ep08
programme.desc: Nukumizu and Komari become vice president and president of the literature club. Yanami proposes an idea for their exhibition at the Tsuwabuki Festival. Things seem to be going well, but...

programme.title: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! Ep09
programme.desc: While preparing for the festival, Nukumizu and Komari catch Tamaki and Koto on a date. Unable to interact with them like before, Komari decides to prepare the exihibit's manuscript alone.

programme.title: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! Ep10
programme.desc: Preparation for the exhibition is complete and Komari returns. At the festival, Nukumizu and Komari tour around the campus. Later, Koto talks to Nukumizu while Komari is alone with Tamaki...

programme.title: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! Ep11
programme.desc: Komari struggles to practice for the club presidents' meeting. Upon Yanami's suggestion, they head out but Nukumizu and Komari end up arguing. They remain at odds as the meeting day arrives.

programme.title: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! Ep12
programme.desc: Yanami ropes the club members into her 'fake boyfriend project', leading to a mock date between her and Nukumizu. Ms. Konuki gifts some tickets to Non Hoi Park, which becomes the date venue.

programme.title: PUELLA MAGI MADOKA MAGICA SIDE STORY MAGIA RECORD 2nd SEASON -The Eve of Awakening- Ep02
programme.desc: To track down the location of Magius base, Yachiyo hunts down Black Feathers. She encounters Kuroe and a small Kyubey. While chasing after Kuroe, Yachiyo bumps into Mifuyu Azusa.

programme.title: PUELLA MAGI MADOKA MAGICA SIDE STORY MAGIA RECORD 2nd SEASON -The Eve of Awakening- Ep03
programme.desc: Yachiyo and Kuroe find Iroha within the 'Perennial Cherry Tree' rumor, where they are devoured by the Doppel of silence. They awaken in a 'dream world', where Yachiyo tries to wake Iroha up.

programme.title: Sacrificial Princess and the King of Beasts Ep09
programme.desc: The event with Galois turns out to be an act to test Sariphi's worthiness as queen. Sariphi gains the support of the ichthyosaureans, but Anubis refuses to accept it...

programme.title: Sacrificial Princess and the King of Beasts Ep10
programme.desc: On the day before a holy fete where the current king stands before his people donning the first king's mantle, a divine night triggers and Leonhart remains in his human form the next day.

programme.title: Tune in to the Midnight Heart Ep03

programme.title: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! Ep04
programme.desc: Komari confesses to Tamaki. Tensions between Koto and Tamaki flare up as Koto leaves the site. Nukumizu escapes reality, but to no avail. Later, Nukumizu hears a rumor about him and Yanami.

programme.title: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! Ep09

Plus, see what happens when Buster gets sick and his friend Scout fetches Amber the Ambulance to help him feel better.

programme.title: Go Buster
programme.desc: Buster is always there to save the day! He rescues a puppy that gets stuck in a tree. When Bandit is making his friend Ash feel left out at his birthday party, Buster steps in. He goes on an adventure and helps a T-Rex find its lost egg. He even becomes Super Buster to find a lost hat and saves his friends when they get stuck in the mud at the construction site.

programme.title: Gecko's Garage
programme.desc: It's a day of pure adventure for Gecko and his friends! The fun starts when a brand new bouncy castle arrives at the garage. Afterward, the weather turns chilly, and the trucks have a wonderful time playing in the snow. This story is all about finding fun and excitement in every situation.

programme.title: Gecko's Garage
programme.desc: Get ready for some amazing adventures with Gecko and friends! When Tilly the tow truck gets sick before a beach trip, Trevor helps create a sandy surprise at the garage. Weasel causes a cake catastrophe and Gecko has to save the day. The team fixes Fiona's control panel during a campout and when Blue gets lost, Gecko comes to the rescue. It's a day of heroes, mysteries and fun!

programme.title: Lellobee City Farm
programme.desc: Get ready for some singing fun at Lellobee City Farm! Learn your ABCs in the Boogie Barn and then learn how to wash your hands before eating some delicious dumplings. Help Ella play 'Mummy Duck' and keep all the baby ducks together. When accidents happen, sing a boo boo song to feel better. End the day with a special Chinese lullaby from Grandma Mei at a sleepover.

programme.title: Lellobee City Farm
programme.desc: Get ready for a farming sing-along! When Ella is feeling anxious, she does the five senses shakedown to feel better. She and Rishi play a game of 'I Hear With My Little Ear' to find all the animals on the farm. Do the ABC dance, go stargazing with Grandma Mei and take care of five mischievous monkeys. Plus, learn that it's okay to make mistakes and that tidying up can be fun.

programme.title: Minibods
programme.desc: Get ready to build a Snowbod! Pogo wants to show Lulu how fun snow can be, so they build a snowman together, but the sun comes out and starts to melt it! Lulu reads a story about a magical Snowhoof and sets off to find it in real life. On the ice, Fuse gets impatient when Jeff can't learn how to skate as quickly as the others.

programme.title: Minibods
programme.desc: Gather 'round for storytime! Jeff gets a new book but doesn't want to share it with the other Minibods. Newt finds an injured Oddfrog and tries to nurse it back to health. Bubbles gets stage fright before a big show and has to find her confidence. She also finds a giant bubble and tries to take it home without it popping.

programme.title: The Vanished Murderer
programme.desc: In this sequel to THE BULLET VANISHES, Sean Lau plays an inspector who is lead down a rabbit hole of discovery as he investigates a prison escape.

programme.title: Better Days
programme.desc: A high school student befriends a street punk as she copes with college entrance exam pressure and ruthless bullying. A murder investigation is set to alter both their lives.

programme.title: All's Well End's Well Too
programme.desc: Another super comedy directed by Clifton Ko about more farcical couplings, mistaken identities, infidelities, and arranged marriages set in the Sung Dynasty.

programme.title: Don't Forget I Love You
programme.desc: Lu Yao has amnesia & wakes up every day remembering nothing from the day before. He meets psychotherapist Xing Yue & they fall in love despite knowing they have no future together.

programme.title: Busted Water Pipes
programme.desc: With no crime left in town, officer Yu Da Hai stages a fake robbery to save the police from losing their jobs. When a water pipe bursts, chaos erupts and the lines between cops and crooks blur.

programme.title: WE 12
programme.desc: 12 elite members of an underground organization who possess extraordinary skills need to revive their team spirit and reunite to save the world from disaster.

programme.title: We Girls
programme.desc: Gao is in prison as she steals to buy a cochlear implant for her daughter. She befriends 3 women there and upon release, they stand together to defy fate and support each other in life's challenges.

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: When a former boxing champ & a rich man's son both enter an MMA competition, they believe they are powerful - until they meet an even more formidable opponent.

programme.title: God of Gambler's Return
programme.desc: A Taiwanese crime boss wants to become the new God of Gamblers, so he kills Gao Jin's pregnant wife. Gao Jin is indignant and vows to fight the crime boss to avenge his wife's death.

programme.title: Tainted Love
programme.desc: Zhou Ran falls prey to an online dating scam. Tracing the scammer's clues, she reaches a coastal town and encounters two young men. Uncovering their involvement, her revenge plot unfolds.

programme.title: Man On the Edge
programme.desc: A triad leader assigns his right-hand man Ah Lok to take charge of the drug trafficking business, but Ah Lok is actually an undercover policeman who unveils a shocking political conspiracy.

programme.title: Dead To Rights
programme.desc: During the 1937 Nanjing Massacre, civilians hiding in Ji Xiang Studio are forced to develop film for the Japanese army, uncovering its atrocities and risking their lives to expose the truth.

programme.title: Tales from the Occult
programme.desc: An anthology of 3 horrifying tales; a singer spirals when spooky things happen in her home; a livestream ends with an influencer's death; the battle between residents & a creature in the stairwell.

programme.title: Flashover
programme.desc: Based on a true story, an earthquake causes the gas pipes in an industrial park to break, resulting in explosions & fires in the area. Firefighters must fight to safeguard lives, including their own.

programme.title: Love at First Lie
programme.desc: Ordinary girl Bao meets troubled rich guy Edward. They conspire to ruin his father's remarriage and love blossoms. However, their romance takes an unexpected turn...

programme.title: High Forces
programme.desc: An A380 airliner is hijacked by gunmen on its maiden flight. Among the passengers is a security expert, whose daughter is one of the captives. Can he save all the passengers and avert the crisis?

programme.title: Love Is The Only Answer
programme.desc: When a flash of her groom's infidelity is revealed at their wedding, Bo cancels the entire affair. However, within a year, he comes knocking on her door again.

programme.title: Caught In Time
programme.desc: Based on a string of real robberies and murder cases, a detective engages in a mouse-and-cat game with the 'Eagle Gang', a group of sophisticated, well-trained and ruthless robbers.

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Caught in an underground fight to pay off debts, talented boxer Jia Yang loses her Olympics dream and quits boxing. A decade later, Coach Li aids her comeback. Can Jia Yang resurrect her boxing dream?

programme.title: Oversteer
programme.desc: Feng defies his father and leaves home to pursue his dream of becoming an auto mechanic. Along the way, he unexpectedly finds himself drawn into the thrilling world of car racing.

programme.title: Call Me Agent
programme.desc: Miu Ling, who dreams of becoming a secret agent, accidentally rescues an injured spy. He agrees to make her his apprentice, turning her upside down as she goes on madcap adventures.

programme.title: Scare Out
programme.desc: A leak of advanced fighter jet technology sparks a national security crisis. As an intel unit's urban spy hunt falters, suspicion turns inward. Two elite agents face off in a silent, ruthless duel.

programme.title: 77 Heartwarmings
programme.desc: After breaking up with Adam, Eva focuses on her career, but Adam is determined to win her back and makes 77 attempts to do so. The situation worsens when a Thai movie idol courts Eva

programme.title: Cyber Heist
programme.desc: After a security engineer unwittingly becomes involved in a money laundering operation, he must fight against his boss in the cyber world to prove his innocence.

programme.title: My Blue Summer
programme.desc: Zhi has been secretly in love with high school classmate Nan from the moment they met. They finally become close friends when they entered the same university, but will Zhi ever confess his feelings?

programme.title: Call Of Heroes
programme.desc: Sean Lau, Louise Koo & Eddie Peng star in this action-packed story of a group of villagers who stand up to a cruel young warlord to protect their home.

programme.title: Shadows
programme.desc: Ching is a forensic psychiatrist who can enter a person's subconscious. As she investigates a murder-cum-suicide case, she finds herself under suspicion and comes face-to-face with a past trauma...

programme.title: Detective Dee and Nine-storey Demon Buil
programme.desc: Detective Dee investigates a series of strange incidents at Tang's building, finding the master suspicious when even his eldest daughter secretly tells Dee of his odd behavior.

programme.title: Detective Chinatown 1900
programme.desc: In 1900s San Francisco, the murder of a white woman in Chinatown ignites public outrage. Two Chinese detectives race against time to uncover the true killer amid mounting tension and danger.

programme.title: The White Storm 2 : Drug Lords
programme.desc: In this epic action-thriller starring Andy Lau & Louis Koo, a bounty of USD $100 million awaits those who successfully capture the biggest drug dealer in Hong Kong.

programme.title: The Invisible Guest
programme.desc: Joanna is a suspect of a locked-room murder where her lover is found dead. When the police investigates the case, they discover another murder case which leads them to the truth.

programme.title: L Storm
programme.desc: ICAC officer Luk and Inspector Lau are stuck in their investigation for bribery and money laundering cases. Framed for bribery, Luk risks everything to gather evidence to clear his name.

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A Japanese security agent teams up with a master thief to recover counterfeit USD plates until a U.S. Embassy official betrays them and escapes to Korea with the prize.

programme.title: Stand Up Story
programme.desc: Mancer cares for his intellectually challenged father Wah. When Mancer finds solace in stand-up comedy, he turns his life's hardships into comedic gold, from school ridicule to pandemic woes.

programme.title: Ultimate Malevolence
programme.desc: Featuring three stories about two high school friends, a magician and a lost man, the movie reveals the most terrifying and ugly side of human nature, where life and death are just a thought away!

programme.title: Sky on Fire
programme.desc: Directed by Ringo Lam, Daniel Wu stars as a security chief embroiled in a battle to protect a cure for deadly disease from falling into the wrong hands. Joseph Chang & Zhang Ruo Yun co-star.

programme.title: Busted Water Pipes
programme.desc: With no crime left in town, officer Yu Da Hai stages a fake robbery to save the police from losing their jobs. When a water pipe bursts, chaos erupts and the lines between cops and crooks blur.

programme.title: Possession Street
programme.desc: When seven vengeful spirits turn the tenants of a deserted mall into zombies, a video store owner, his daughter and a feng shui master must battle the zombies as the mall descends into hell.

programme.title: Someone Like Me
programme.desc: Ah Mei, bound by cerebral palsy and her mother's push for a forced hysterectomy, finds love with Ken through a disability intimacy service. Together, they forge a tender bond that defies all barriers.

programme.title: Burning Stars
programme.desc: During the 1920s White Terror period, agent Li Yimin is tasked with escorting a key figure to safety. Alone and hunted, he reunites with an old ally to escape the enemy's trap.

programme.title: Wild City
programme.desc: Hong Kong director Ringo Lam returns after seven years with this action drama in which a cop-turned-bar-owner & his brother are pulled into a gang war.

programme.title: The Last Dance
programme.desc: Debt-ridden wedding planner, Sheng, finds a lifeline as he transitions into a funeral planner. Inspired by the respected Master Wen, Sheng gradually changes his attitude towards his career and life.

programme.title: Article 20
programme.desc: Prosecutor Han Ming battles a case of intentional injury, risking all for justice. In a gripping finale, he transforms it into a fight for fairness, defending what is right.

programme.title: Detective Vs. Sleuths
programme.desc: Hong Kong is rocked by a series of cold-blooded murders whose victims are runaway suspects of unsolved cases. The group of killers calls themselves "The Chosen Sleuths'. Former top detective Lee vows to bring the brutal killers to justice and prove himself to be the real "Chosen Sleuth" instead of a lunatic.

programme.title: The Ex-Files 4: Marriage Plan
programme.desc: Two brothers, Yun and Fei, face challenges in love. Yun dodges family pressure to marry after his breakup, and Fei and his girlfriend opt for a 'marriage cooling-off period' to tackle marriage issues.

programme.title: She's Got No Name
programme.desc: In 1945 Shanghai, a gruesome murder shocks "Jiang Yuan Nong" when the frail Zhan Zhou Shi kills and dismembers her husband. As dark truths emerge, the fate of everyone involved begins to twist.

programme.title: Twilight of the Warriors: Walled In
programme.desc: Young Chan Lok Kwun accidentally stumbles into the dangerous Kowloon Walled City, subsequently finding purpose amid chaos and gaining wisdom while becoming one of the City's protectors.

programme.title: Look Up
programme.desc: Celebrating the 25th anniversary of HK's Handover with an anthology of 4 stories about an autistic young man, a reconciliation, a Chinese opera star & a Nepali youth.

programme.title: Ultimate Revenge
programme.desc: A series of jewellery heists rocks the city. As Officer Cheng Zhi Bun hunts the culprits, he discovers the gang leaders are the long-wanted Yuen brothers, unearthing a buried secret.

programme.title: As It Burns
programme.desc: Detective Wei investigates a fatal explosion involving two women who look alike. As he delves deeper, Wei unveils a web of deceit as details from the past and present come together in unexpected ways.

programme.title: Lonely Eighteen
programme.desc: Two best friends enter the Hong Kong Entertainment industry together in the 1980s but their fates differ. After a decade, their life choices lead them to two different paths in life.

programme.title: 8 Bucks Tycoon
programme.desc: When a struggling painter receives a magical wallet that endlessly produces RM8 notes, his life transforms from hardship to luxury. However, is this miracle truly a blessing or a hidden curse?

programme.title: Sons of the Neon Night
programme.desc: In snowy, surreal Hong Kong, an explosion kills a secret drug lord tycoon. As chaos erupts, his youngest son fights his fugitive brother and warring factions to destroy the family's criminal empire.

programme.title: My Indian Boyfriend
programme.desc: The first Bollywood movie made in Hong Kong, it is about an interracial love story between a Hong Kong girl and an Indian boy! Faced with many difficulties, can their love prevail?

programme.title: Iceman The Time Traveler
programme.desc: Defrosted in modern Hong Kong, four imperial guards return in pursuit of the Golden Wheel of Time. As Ying seeks to rewrite the past, he unknowingly steps into a deadly trap.

programme.title: One and Only
programme.desc: A veteran and a passionate street dancer both strive to reach their goals and pursue their dreams in street dancing. After overcoming many challenges, can they finally shine on stage?

programme.title: Ultimate Revenge
programme.desc: A series of jewellery heists rocks the city. As Officer Cheng Zhi Bun hunts the culprits, he discovers the gang leaders are the long-wanted Yuen brothers, unearthing a buried secret.

programme.title: Smashing Frank
programme.desc: After a jewelry store heist, the young thieves left behind a graffiti tag that reads 'FRANK', sparking public curiosity about their motives. What message are they trying to convey?

programme.title: Lelio Popo
programme.desc: Famous radio DJs Jiang Man Da and Lu Ye Chang are fired and blacklisted. To make a comeback, they disguise themselves as elderly women to host a new radio show sparking unexpected success and comedy.

programme.title: The Bride With White Hair II
programme.desc: Powerful, insane and obsessed with hatred, the bride with white hair has gone on a killing rampage, and can only be stopped by the one person she loves.

programme.title: The Leakers
programme.desc: A deadly artificial virus erupts in Malaysia as a pharmaceutical company profits from a monopoly on the cure. Hong Kong and Malaysian police join a journalist and hackers to expose the conspiracy.

programme.title: Legend of the Fist:The Return of Chen Zhen
programme.desc: As Japan's grip on China tightens, Chen Zhen returns to Shanghai to infiltrate the notorious Club Casablanca, whose owner is a Japanese collaborator.

programme.title: The Movie Emperor
programme.desc: A Hong Kong megastar decides to make a film about rural China to win an award at a film festival. He experiences village life for a farmer's role, but this results in a series of hilarious events.

programme.title: My Country, My Parents
programme.desc: Set against four different eras, this 4-part anthology directed by Wu Jing, Zhang Zi Yi, Xu Zheng & Shen Teng depicts how China's forefathers fought to defend the nation & family honour.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: Plotting to seize a massive inheritance from a dying tycoon, a mercenary 'relativei hires Tricky Star to steal the will in order to alter it.

programme.title: Panda Plan
programme.desc: Legendary kung fu star Jackie Chan adopts a panda names Hu Hu. When a crime syndicate places a bounty on the panda, Jackie, his agent, and Hu Hu's caretaker embark on a quest to outsmart the villains.

programme.title: One More Chance
programme.desc: Chow Yun-Fat plays the unlucky gambler Chui Sui-Fai, whose ex-girlfriend asks him to take care of their autistic son. He reluctantly agreed and the two slowly begin to build their relationship.

programme.title: Dead Talents Society
programme.desc: Newbie ghost Rookie must prove herself in the afterlife by delivering spectacular scares. A washed-up ghost diva and her agent help her battle to earn her haunting licence, or else she will vanish.

programme.title: Table for Six 2
programme.desc: Bernard and Lung plan to get married when their eldest brother is away. Yet, the weddings spiral into a chaotic battleground with escalating family drama, creating a messy affair for all involved!

programme.title: Schemes in Antiques
programme.desc: Despite his family's expertise in ancient Chinese relics, Xu Yuan resents their fraudulent ways. However, when fate shows him a route to redeeming their reputation, will he survive it?

programme.title: Valley Of The Shadow Of Death
programme.desc: Years after his daughter's tragic death from assault, the offender resurfaces in church to ask for forgiveness. Torn between his faith and humanity, Pastor Leung faces a profound test.

programme.title: Inexternal
programme.desc: Ming falls into coma and is transported to a fantasy realm where old Master Turtle teaches him ancient boxing skill to defeat an evil boss. Meanwhile, Ming's mother finds a way to save her son.

programme.title: Montages of a Modern Motherhood
programme.desc: Shu Zhen's life takes a downturn after giving birth. Exhausted by childcare, ignored by her husband and burdened by in-laws and work, she endures lonely nights. Will dawn bring her hope or despair?

programme.title: Cliff Walkers
programme.desc: Zhang Yi Mou's first spy thriller follows four Communist Party special agents who embark on a secret mission in the Japanese puppet state of Manchukuo - only to be sold out by a traitor.

programme.title: Life Must Go On
programme.desc: When the midnight gymnasium programme for wayward teenage girls is at risk of closing down due to funding, social worker Yanki puts together a dodgeball team to compete in a match to save it.

programme.title: Busted Water Pipes
programme.desc: With no crime left in town, officer Yu Da Hai stages a fake robbery to save the police from losing their jobs. When a water pipe bursts, chaos erupts and the lines between cops and crooks blur.

programme.title: Customs Frontline
programme.desc: The Hong Kong Customs officers uncover illegal weapons on a cargo ship linked to an international conflict. Elite agents go undercover and reveal a multinational operation with ties closer to home.

programme.title: Always Have Always Will
programme.desc: A struggling young man encounters a spirited girl and embarks on an uncertain journey. Together they share joys and sorrows, supporting each other through highs and lows, bringing light to darkness.

programme.title: Beauty And The 7 Beasts
